entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: A wizard mercenary, former Icatian soldier and Ebon Hand defector, who stirred up an orc-goblin army against Icatia, and later sides with the dwarves and thrulls.

entities.name: Melelki
entities.description: A dwarven woman who sold Reod dragon eggs and travels with him.

entities.name: Tamun
entities.description: Melelki's daughter who falls in love with Reod and wants to marry him.

entities.name: Sekena
entities.description: Melelki's daughter, who has a strong bond with dragons and rescues her family.

entities.name: Eliza
entities.description: Reod's long-time friend, now a Farrelite, who rescues him from the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Genkr
entities.description: An Ebon Hand wizard and Reod's former teacher who tortures him for the goblin egg secrets.

entities.name: Hamon
entities.description: The dwarf elder of Gurn Keep.

entities.name: Havenwood elves
entities.description: Elves who hired Reod to cause trouble, then cancelled his contract, and who breed thallids for food.

entities.name: Ebon Hand
entities.description: A sworn enemy of Icatia whose dark secrets the elves use; they seek goblin eggs and want Reod dead.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: An oppressive, fanatical kingdom, sworn enemy of the Ebon Hand, which Reod once served.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Creatures serving the Ebon Hand who rebel against their creators after Reod's urging.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Fungus creatures bred by the elves as food, who gain sentience and rebel.

entities.name: Orc-goblin army
entities.description: The huge army Reod created, which destroys Kalitas and attacks the dwarves.

entities.name: Teedmar
entities.description: A dwarven city buried under lava after the Ebon Hand's volcano erupts.

entities.name: Kalitas
entities.description: A dwarven town destroyed by the orc-goblin army.

entities.name: Havenwood
entities.description: The elves' fortress and thallid farm.

entities.name: Achtep Keep
entities.description: The stronghold of the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Gurn Keep
entities.description: A dwarven keep besieged by the orc-goblin army.

entities.name: Crimson Peaks
entities.description: Mountains where the dwarves live and a great dragon dwells.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: The plane where the novel is set.

events.summary: Reod Dai meets an elf emissary in the Crimson Peaks and learns his contract has been cut abruptly.
events.quote: However, the contract is cut abruptly.

events.summary: A dragon hatches prematurely and attacks the dwarves' hut; Reod saves them by making the whelp explode.
events.quote: Reod Dai can save them by causing the dragon whelp to explode

events.summary: Reod's seduction spell backfires, causing him and Tamun to fall in love.
events.quote: causing the two to fall in love

events.summary: On the road the group passes Kalitas, destroyed by the orc-goblin army, and learns it marches on Teedmar.
events.quote: they pass by Kalitas, a dwarven town that has been destroyed by the orc-goblin army

events.summary: Tamun and Reod are forced to kill an Icatian patrol, and Reod's past as the Icatian soldier Robin Davis is revealed.
events.quote: Reod was an Icatian soldier, born Robin Davis

events.summary: At Havenwood Reod tries to blow up the elves' thallid farm, but it is protected from magic and two eggs hatch without exploding.
events.quote: Reod Dai tries to blow up the Thallid farm of the elves

events.summary: Sekena, tired of seeing dragon eggs explode, leaves the group to fight at Teedmar.
Reod, Melelki and Tamun bury eggs around the elves' fortress and are captured.
events.quote: before being spotted and captured by the elves

events.summary: Reod escapes prison with the help of an elven child, blowing up the buried eggs and causing a great fire.
events.quote: not before blowing up the buried eggs, causing a great fire

events.summary: Sekena and her whelps reach the Crimson Peaks, where a great dragon invites them to live in his cavern.
events.quote: invites her and the whelps to live in his cavern

events.summary: At Teedmar Reod and Eliza are ambushed by an Ebon Hand wizard, who reveals thallids have gained sentience and the Hand caused the volcano to erupt.
events.quote: they had caused the volcano near Teedmar to erupt, to kill the dwarves for selling weapons to Icatia

events.summary: The volcano buries Teedmar under lava while the wizard teleports Reod and Eliza to Achtep Keep.
events.quote: they find the city buried under the lava

events.summary: Reod and Eliza are locked up by the Thrulls, and Reod incites them to rebel.
events.quote: he and Eliza are locked up in a cell by the Thrulls

events.summary: Eliza rescues Reod from torture, the thrulls kill the Ebon Hand, and Reod promises to aid their revolt.
events.quote: The thrulls kill the members of the Ebon Hand

events.summary: Reod reaches Gurn Keep and agrees to help the dwarves resist, but is jailed as a suspected spy and the keep is invaded.
events.quote: Reod agrees to help the dwarves with their resistance

events.summary: Sekena flies her dragon to the keep and carries Reod, Melelki and Tamun away; Tamun says she still wants to marry him.
events.quote: she still wants to marry him

relations.note: They fall in love after his spell backfires.
relations.quote: causing the two to fall in love
Melelki and her daughters Tamun and Sekena
Melelki and her daughters Tamun and Sekena

relations.note: Paid by them to stir up trouble.
relations.quote: He has been paid by the Elves to stir up trouble

relations.note: Defected from Icatia to the Ebon Hand.
Reod's teacher when he was an acolyte.
relations.quote: his teacher when he was an acolyte
